text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while working overtime in the Trainer's
Office to clear through piled-up work...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: ...Cheval? What's wrong?
...Cheval? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-No... It's nothing at all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just what could she have needed...?
Though puzzled, I went back to processing paperwork.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I was tackling the remaining work once again.
As I kept working while fighting off fatigue—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
G-Good evening, Trainer.
Um...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, do you
understand the importance of sleep?"
choice_data_list: Huh... What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
Huh... What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-If you don't get enough sleep, you catch colds more easily,
and it raises your risk for high blood pressure and diabetes.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
S-So... staying up late is bad, and...
as for why I'm awake at this hour, um...
choice_data_list: True. In that case, you need to go to sleep early!
True. In that case, you need to get to bed early!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh?! ...Ah, um...! Th-This isn't about me, though...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I shouldn't be up either,
...but that's not the point I'm trying to make!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway... w-what I'm trying to say is...
...um—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: H-Hey...!
choice_data_list: ...Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-You can't tell...!?
I-I'm... angry right now.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: After all, even last night—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I'm glad I noticed I forgot to bring my jersey home...
I have to put it in the laundry before I go to sleep.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Wait, huh?
The lights are on in the trainer's office...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Trainer is still working.
Working so hard, late into the night...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...Still, you look tired, don't you? I'm a little worried...)
choice_data_list: ...Cheval? What's wrong?
...Cheval? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-No... It's nothing at all...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... again.
The lights in the Trainer's office are still on today...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Every single day...
Keep this up and you'll wreck your body eventually...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...T-That's right. I have to tell them! Not to push themselves too hard... I have to...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...I don't know if I can do it, but...
I hate the thought of just looking away—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......I-I have to get angry.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, that's what happened...
That's why I..."
choice_data_list: You were looking out for me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......I-I'm sorry I couldn't
get angry properly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...I can't cause my Trainee any more worry. I shut down the computer and stood up from my chair."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's call it a day!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes...
In that case, I'm glad...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so glad I mustered up my courage...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during training. While I was stretching,
Cheval Grand came over.
choice_data_list: Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...G-Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Trainer...
Your color's looking better...
choice_data_list: Looks like my stamina's finally coming back
Yeah, I'm bursting with motivation!
Yeah, I'm bursting with motivation!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Trainer...
Your color's looking better...
choice_data_list: Looks like my stamina's finally coming back
Yeah, I'm bursting with motivation!
Yeah, I'm bursting with motivation!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-If that's the case, I'm glad...
choice_data_list: Thanks for checking in on me the other day!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all...
It's really nothing you need to thank me for...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still, please...
I'd really appreciate it if you wouldn't push yourself anymore...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
I-I'll do my best too...
choice_data_list: But don't overdo the solo training, okay?
But don't overdo the solo training on your own, okay?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh... You noticed that I've been
going for runs at night...?
choice_data_list: Let's both try our best not to overdo it!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Likewise for both of us... hehe...
